prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

Provided is a heat treatment apparatus capable of being configured to be more compact. A heat treatment apparatus 1 includes a coolant passage defining body 42 to define a coolant passage 48 to supply a coolant to a workpiece 100. The coolant passage defining body 42 includes an upper member 50 and a lower member 40 as a plurality of coolant passage defining members, and is configured so that, by displacing these members 49 and 50 so as to approach each other along an up-down direction Z1 crossing a conveyance direction, the coolant passage 48 is defined in a state housing the workpiece 100. In addition, the coolant passage defining body is configured so that, by displacing the members 49 and 50 described above so as to separate from each other along the up-down direction Z1, the workpiece 100 is allowed to be let into and out of the coolant passage 48 along the conveyance direction A1.

outputs.L1: Provided is a heat treatment apparatus that can be configured more compactly. The heat treatment apparatus 1 includes a coolant passage-defining body 42 that defines a coolant passage 48 for supplying coolant to a workpiece 100. The coolant passage-defining body 42 includes an upper member 50 and a lower member 40 as a plurality of coolant passage-defining members. The coolant passage 48 is defined so as to accommodate the workpiece 100 by displacing the members 49 and 50 toward each other along an up-down direction Z1 intersecting a conveyance direction. In addition, by displacing the members 49 and 50 away from each other along the up-down direction Z1, the coolant passage-defining body allows the workpiece 100 to enter and exit the coolant passage 48 along a conveyance direction A1.
outputs.L2: A heat treatment apparatus that can be made more compact is disclosed. The apparatus 1 has a coolant-passage defining body 42 that forms a coolant passage 48 for delivering coolant to a workpiece 100. The body 42 includes multiple passage-defining components, namely an upper member 50 and a lower member 40. When members 49 and 50 are moved toward one another in an up-down direction Z1 intersecting the conveyance direction, they enclose the workpiece 100 and establish the coolant passage 48. Conversely, moving these members apart in the up-down direction Z1 allows the workpiece 100 to be inserted into and removed from the coolant passage 48 along conveyance direction A1.
outputs.L3:
The heat treatment apparatus is designed with a compact configuration. It includes a coolant passage defining body that forms a passage through which coolant is supplied to a workpiece. The coolant passage defining body includes upper and lower members that are movable relative to each other in an up-down direction intersecting the workpiece conveyance direction.

When the upper and lower members move toward each other, they form the coolant passage around the workpiece, allowing coolant to be supplied for heat treatment. When the members move apart, the passage is opened so that the workpiece can enter or exit along the conveyance direction. This arrangement enables efficient workpiece handling and coolant delivery while reducing the overall size of the apparatus.
outputs.L4:
A heat treatment apparatus is configured to cool a workpiece efficiently while reducing the space required for loading, cooling, and unloading operations. The apparatus includes an upper member positioned above a conveyance path and a lower member positioned below the conveyance path. At least one of these members is movable in the vertical direction so that the upper and lower members can approach and separate from each other.

When a workpiece is conveyed to a cooling position, the upper and lower members move toward each other and surround at least part of the workpiece. In this closed position, the members define a coolant passage around the workpiece. A cooling medium is supplied through the passage and brought into contact with, or circulated near, the workpiece to cool it uniformly and rapidly after heating. The close arrangement of the coolant passage around the workpiece improves cooling efficiency and limits unnecessary coolant dispersion.

After cooling is completed, the upper and lower members move apart vertically. This opens the conveyance path and allows the cooled workpiece to be discharged in the same general conveyance direction in which it entered. A subsequent workpiece can then be introduced into the cooling position without requiring the cooling members to swing outward or move laterally.

Because the upper and lower members open and close vertically, the apparatus does not require substantial space on either side of the conveyance path. The workpiece can therefore be loaded and unloaded along a substantially straight path while the coolant passage is formed only when cooling is performed. This arrangement enables a compact apparatus configuration, simplifies integration with upstream and downstream processing equipment, and supports efficient continuous or sequential heat treatment of workpieces.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a compact heat treatment apparatus with upper and lower members that form a coolant passage around a workpiece.
counterfactuals.output: A compact heat treatment apparatus includes an upper member and a lower member movable relative to one another between an open position for receiving a workpiece and a closed position surrounding at least a treatment region of the workpiece. The upper and lower members collectively define a coolant passage extending around the treatment region when in the closed position. At least one coolant inlet and at least one coolant outlet communicate with the coolant passage to provide controlled coolant flow about the workpiece. Sealing elements disposed between the members and/or the workpiece limit coolant leakage. A heating device is configured to heat the treatment region before or during closure of the members, after which coolant is circulated through the passage to rapidly and substantially uniformly cool the workpiece. The integrated arrangement reduces equipment size, coolant consumption, and transfer time between heating and cooling operations.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention in which two coolant-passage-defining members move toward and away from each other vertically, allowing a workpiece to enter and exit along a conveyance direction.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention is a split coolant-applying apparatus for a conveyed workpiece. It includes upper and lower coolant-passage-defining members arranged on opposite sides of the workpiece’s conveyance path. At least one member moves vertically so that the members can:

- **Separate vertically**, opening the passage for the workpiece to enter or leave in the conveyance direction; and  
- **Approach or contact each other**, forming a coolant passage around or adjacent to the workpiece.

Once closed, coolant is supplied through the passage to cool the workpiece uniformly. After cooling, the members separate again, permitting the workpiece to continue along the conveyance line.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise technical summary of a heat treatment apparatus designed to reduce equipment size by using a separable coolant passage body.
counterfactuals.output: The heat treatment apparatus includes a treatment chamber for heating a workpiece and a cooling unit containing a coolant passage. The coolant passage is formed in a separable body that can be divided and removed during assembly or maintenance. This structure allows the cooling unit to be installed around or near other chamber components without requiring a large insertion space, thereby reducing the apparatus footprint while maintaining efficient, uniform cooling and simplifying servicing.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft an English patent abstract based on this concept: a workpiece is conveyed horizontally into a cooling area, upper and lower members close vertically to define a coolant passage, and then separate to release the workpiece.
counterfactuals.output: A cooling apparatus and method for cooling a workpiece are disclosed. The workpiece is conveyed in a horizontal direction into a cooling area between an upper member and a lower member. At least one of the upper and lower members is moved vertically toward the other to close around the workpiece and define a coolant passage through which a coolant is supplied to cool the workpiece. After cooling, the upper and lower members are moved apart vertically, thereby releasing the workpiece for horizontal conveyance out of the cooling area.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Explain the configuration and operation of a compact heat treatment apparatus 1 comprising a coolant passage defining body 42, coolant passage 48, upper member 50, lower member 40, and workpiece 100, using formal patent language.
counterfactuals.output:
A compact heat treatment apparatus 1 includes a lower member 40, an upper member 50 disposed in opposed relation to the lower member 40, and a coolant passage defining body 42 provided between or integrally associated with the lower member 40 and the upper member 50. The coolant passage defining body 42 defines at least one coolant passage 48 through which a temperature-control coolant is circulated. The upper member 50 and the lower member 40 cooperatively support, position, or accommodate a workpiece 100 in a predetermined heat-treatment position adjacent to the coolant passage 48.

During operation, the workpiece 100 is heated to, or maintained at, a prescribed treatment temperature by a suitable heating source. Coolant is thereafter, or concurrently, introduced into the coolant passage 48. Heat is transferred from the workpiece 100 through at least one of the upper member 50, the lower member 40, and the coolant passage defining body 42 to the coolant flowing through the coolant passage 48. The heated coolant is discharged from the coolant passage 48 and may be recirculated through an external temperature-control system.

Because the coolant passage 48 is arranged in close proximity to the workpiece 100, the thermal transfer path is shortened, thereby enabling rapid and controlled cooling of the workpiece 100. The opposed arrangement of the upper member 50 and the lower member 40 may further restrain deformation of the workpiece 100 and promote substantially uniform heat treatment. Integration of the coolant passage defining body 42 with the upper and lower members provides a reduced installation volume and permits the apparatus 1 to perform controlled heating, cooling, or quenching within a compact structure.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
